title.en: Compare two devices on the same recipe: same plan length, different rungs

goal.en: Two kitchen robots with the same operations and different sensors both plan lentil soup. The plans have the same eleven steps; the verification column is where they differ.

note.en: Without thermometers: heating, boiling and hot holding are logged estimates.
With thermometers: pan surface, liquid and core temperature verify the same three steps.
The difference is four sensors in the capability documents.
Both robots cut the vegetables under their camera; the knife step is identical.

outcome.en: You can diff two devices by the rung each step gets, which is a fair way to compare products: not what they accept, but what they verify. Next: scenario 010 does the same with estimates forbidden.
